# Stacy

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Stacy is a young woman with lovely, fair curly hair and fascinating eyes. She dresses beautifully and wears sleeve puffs that are larger than anyone else's in Avonlea.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## Personality

Miss Stacy is a bright, sympathetic, and disciplined teacher. She possesses a happy gift for winning and holding the affection of her pupils, bringing out the best in them both mentally and morally. Although gentle and forgiving when pupils make mistakes, she maintains perfect order in her classroom without ever whipping children.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_

## Abilities

- maintaining perfect order without whipping pupils  <sub>[v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)</sub>
- winning pupils' affection and bringing out their best  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>

## History

Miss Muriel Stacy was hired by the trustees as Avonlea's first female schoolteacher. Upon taking up her post, she introduced fresh teaching methods, including biweekly recitation afternoons, field days in the woods to study nature, and daily physical culture exercises. She formed a dedicated Queen's class to prepare pupils for the Entrance examinations to Queen's Academy. At one point, she was offered a position in the grade school of her home district, but she returned to Avonlea to teach the class through their final year. At the end of June, her tenure as Avonlea's schoolteacher came to a close, leaving her pupils deeply moved as she said her farewells. She advised Anne Shirley and Gilbert Blythe to take up Second Year work at Queen's Academy to obtain First Class licenses in a single year.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c31 P10](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0010), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011)_
